title: iScanner is a major upgrade to your desktop scanner, and with this Labor Day discount it’s only $24.97
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: Replace the scanner taking up space on your desk with a lifetime subscription to the portable, feature-packed iScanner App, on sale for Labor Day for just $24.97, 88% off the $199 regular price.

You need to scan, but that doesn’t mean you need a bulky desktop scanner: With the iScanner app, you get more features and more convenience than your old machine offers, and right now new users can get a lifetime subscription for just $24.97 with Labor Day savings.

With the iScanner app, you get access to features your old-fashioned scanner can only dream of. That means:

  • AI tools that adjusts document borders, straightens crooked scans, and eliminates skew
  • Text recognition that works with more than 20 languages
  • Markup tools that give you serious editing ability: color correct, make notes, cover up and blur text, and remove scan noise
  • Secure confidential documents with PIN codes and locked folders, and add watermarks
  • Merge pages, or split them apart
  • Add page numbers, headers, and footers to documents

Whether you’re scanning handwritten notes, business receipts, family photos, books, or cards, iScanner lets you make digital versions of your important items anywhere you and your phone find yourselves — no more being locked to your desk. You also get 200 MB of storage included with your lifetime subscription, giving you an additional method to securely store your notes, invoices, contracts and files. Your digitized files can be saved as PDFs, JPGs, or DOC files for easy sharing, and you can even convert them into PowerPoint, Excel, or TXT files for editing and conversion.

About 125 million small business owners, students, professionals and other users have chosen iScanner to make their phone into the powerful document processor their desktop scanner can’t be. And with these Labor Day savings, there’s never been a better time to join them.

Get a lifetime subscription to the iScanner App for $24.97 (reg. $199). Labor Day sale ends September 10 at 11:59PM PT.
